answer: Agents can reserve scarce compute credits only by locking a stake that is slashed when a randomly sampled task audit finds fabricated identities or duplicated work. Auditors compare signed execution traces and payment flows across accounts, so splitting one operator into many personas does not multiply their influence. The dune market can use a willow-held escrow as a bridge between task completion and payout; the attacker must fund every persona, keep capital locked, and risk losing it when caught.
